comment: Context-free translations were written from the complete elaborated signatures and recursively expanded result semantics; declaration spelling was used only as a row locator.

completeMarriageOutcome_iff_source_defin.tex_statement: For arbitrary participant types and an internally consistent optional one-to-one assignment $\mu$, $\mu$ is a complete marriage outcome exactly when every participant on each side is assigned some participant on the other side.

For arbitrary participant types and an internally consistent optional one-to-one assignment $\mu$, $\mu$ is a complete marriage outcome exactly when every participant on each side is assigned some participant on the other side.

corollary5_1_first_choice_need_not_be_mi.tex_statement: For finite nonempty equal-cardinality sides, men-proposing deferred acceptance is men's optimal stable outcome and every legal report by a woman can be replaced by a legal report preserving her true first choice and giving her a weakly better true-ranked outcome; symmetrically, women-proposing deferred acceptance is women's optimal stable outcome and every man's report admits the same first-choice-preserving replacement.

For finite nonempty equal-cardinality sides, men-proposing deferred acceptance is men's optimal stable outcome and every legal report by a woman can be replaced by a legal report preserving her true first choice and giving her a weakly better true-ranked outcome; symmetrically, women-proposing deferred acceptance is women's optimal stable outcome and every man's report admits the same first-choice-preserving replacement.

efficientMatchingProcedure_iff_source_de.tex_statement: A mechanism is efficient exactly when, for every source-legal strict positive two-sided score profile, it returns a complete assignment for which no other complete assignment weakly improves every participant and strictly improves at least one participant.

A mechanism is efficient exactly when, for every source-legal strict positive two-sided score profile, it returns a complete assignment for which no other complete assignment weakly improves every participant and strictly improves at least one participant.

fillsIndividualQuotas_iff_source_definit.tex_statement: For any two participant carriers, individual natural-number quotas, and a mutually consistent two-sided partner-set assignment, the assignment fills individual quotas exactly when every partner set on both sides is finite and has finite cardinality equal to that participant's quota.

For any two participant carriers, individual natural-number quotas, and a mutually consistent two-sided partner-set assignment, the assignment fills individual quotas exactly when every partner set on both sides is finite and has finite cardinality equal to that participant's quota.

lemma1_simple_report_same_partner.tex_statement: For finite sides, if an arbitrary unilateral report gives a man partner $w^*$ and a strict replacement report ranks $w^*$ above every other woman, then men-proposing deferred acceptance under the replacement report assigns that man the same partner as under the arbitrary report.

lemma1_simple_report_same_partnerSpec.tex_statement: For finite sides, if an arbitrary unilateral report gives a man partner $w^*$ and a strict replacement report ranks $w^*$ above every other woman, then men-proposing deferred acceptance under the replacement report assigns that man the same partner as under the arbitrary report.

lemma2_simple_report_harms_no_man.tex_statement: For finite equal-cardinality sides with strict positive true and simple-reported profiles, if the simple report assigns its author $y^*$, ranks $y^*$ first, and leaves its author weakly better off, then every man is weakly better off under the resulting men-proposing deferred-acceptance assignment.

lemma2_simple_report_harms_no_manSpec.tex_statement: For finite equal-cardinality sides with strict positive true and simple-reported profiles, if the simple report assigns its author $y^*$, ranks $y^*$ first, and leaves its author weakly better off, then every man is weakly better off under the resulting men-proposing deferred-acceptance assignment.

manReportStrictlyRanksPartnerFirst_iff_s.tex_statement: Given a reported score function and an obtained partner $w^*$, the report is simple exactly when every different possible partner receives a strictly lower reported score than $w^*$.
Given a reported score function and an obtained partner $w^*$, the report is simple exactly when every different possible partner receives a strictly lower reported score than $w^*$.

matchingProcedure_eq_source_definition.tex_statement: For participant types $M$ and $W$, a matching procedure is exactly a function from a legal two-sided strict preference profile to an internally consistent assignment that matches every participant on both sides.

matchingProcedure_eq_source_definitionSp.tex_statement: For participant types $M$ and $W$, a matching procedure is exactly a function from a legal two-sided strict preference profile to an internally consistent assignment that matches every participant on both sides.

preferenceProfile_eq_source_definition.tex_statement: For participant types $M$ and $W$, a preference profile is exactly a pair of real-valued score tables, one for each side, restricted so that each agent assigns equal scores only to the same potential partner; equivalently, every agent's induced ordering over the opposite side is strict and tie-free.

preferenceProfile_eq_source_definitionSp.tex_statement: For participant types $M$ and $W$, a preference profile is exactly a pair of real-valued score tables, one for each side, restricted so that each agent assigns equal scores only to the same potential partner; equivalently, every agent's induced ordering over the opposite side is strict and tie-free.

sideOptimalStableOutcome_iff_source_defi.tex_statement: For a fixed two-sided profile and assignment $\mu$, men-optimality is equivalent to source stability of $\mu$ plus weak dominance for every man over every source-stable assignment, and symmetrically women-optimality is equivalent to source stability plus weak dominance for every woman.

For a fixed two-sided profile and assignment $\mu$, men-optimality is equivalent to source stability of $\mu$ plus weak dominance for every man over every source-stable assignment, and symmetrically women-optimality is equivalent to source stability plus weak dominance for every woman.

sourceMarriageModel_iff_source_definitio.tex_statement: For finite participant types $M$ and $W$ with score tables $v_M$ and $v_W$, the marriage-model domain holds exactly when $|M|=|W|$ and every agent's score row is injective, hence represents a complete strict ordering without ties over the opposite side.

For finite participant types $M$ and $W$ with score tables $v_M$ and $v_W$, the marriage-model domain holds exactly when $|M|=|W|$ and every agent's score row is injective, hence represents a complete strict ordering without ties over the opposite side.

sourceStableMarriage_iff_source_definiti.tex_statement: For two score profiles and an assignment $\mu$, source stability holds exactly when $\mu$ is complete and there is no pair $(m,w)$ for which both $m$ and $w$ strictly prefer one another to their partners under $\mu$; the syntactic unmatched branch has value zero.

For two score profiles and an assignment $\mu$, source stability holds exactly when $\mu$ is complete and there is no pair $(m,w)$ for which both $m$ and $w$ strictly prefer one another to their partners under $\mu$; the syntactic unmatched branch has value zero.

sourceStableMatchingProcedure_iff_source.tex_statement: A mechanism is source-stable exactly when, for every pair of strict score profiles in which all partners outrank the artificial unmatched option, its output is a complete assignment with no mutually improving unmatched pair.

A mechanism is source-stable exactly when, for every pair of strict score profiles in which all partners outrank the artificial unmatched option, its output is a complete assignment with no mutually improving unmatched pair.

theorem1_stable_outcome_exists.tex_statement: For finite equal-cardinality sides with decidable identities and strict score profiles in which every partner outranks being unmatched, there exists a complete one-to-one assignment with no pair that strictly prefers one another to their assigned partners.

theorem1_stable_outcome_existsSpec.tex_statement: For finite equal-cardinality sides with decidable identities and strict score profiles in which every partner outranks being unmatched, there exists a complete one-to-one assignment with no pair that strictly prefers one another to their assigned partners.

theorem2_side_optimal_stable_outcomes.tex_statement: For finite equal-cardinality sides with strict positive score profiles, there exists a complete stable assignment weakly best for every man among all stable assignments, and there exists a complete stable assignment weakly best for every woman among all stable assignments.

theorem2_side_optimal_stable_outcomesSpe.tex_statement: For finite equal-cardinality sides with strict positive score profiles, there exists a complete stable assignment weakly best for every man among all stable assignments, and there exists a complete stable assignment weakly best for every woman among all stable assignments.

theorem3_no_stable_truthful_procedure.tex_statement: On the finite three-by-three strict marriage domain, there is no mechanism that both returns a complete stable assignment at every reported profile and makes truthful reporting a dominant strategy against every unilateral strict misreport for agents on both sides.

theorem3_no_stable_truthful_procedureSpe.tex_statement: On the finite three-by-three strict marriage domain, there is no mechanism that both returns a complete stable assignment at every reported profile and makes truthful reporting a dominant strategy against every unilateral strict misreport for agents on both sides.

theorem4_efficient_truthful_procedure_ex.tex_statement: For every finite balanced marriage-market size $n$, there exists a matching procedure that is Pareto efficient on every legal strict preference profile and for which truthful reporting is a dominant strategy for every man and every woman.

For every finite balanced marriage-market size $n$, there exists a matching procedure that is Pareto efficient on every legal strict preference profile and for which truthful reporting is a dominant strategy for every man and every woman.

theorem5_optimal_side_truthful.tex_statement: For finite equal-cardinality sides and a strict positive true profile, men-proposing deferred acceptance is the men's optimal stable outcome and no man gains under his true ordering from any legal unilateral report; symmetrically, women-proposing deferred acceptance is the women's optimal stable outcome and no woman gains from any legal unilateral report.

theorem5_optimal_side_truthfulSpec.tex_statement: For finite equal-cardinality sides and a strict positive true profile, men-proposing deferred acceptance is the men's optimal stable outcome and no man gains under his true ordering from any legal unilateral report; symmetrically, women-proposing deferred acceptance is the women's optimal stable outcome and no woman gains from any legal unilateral report.

theorem6_no_outcome_strictly_better_for_.tex_statement: For finite equal-cardinality strict positive marriage profiles with at least one man, there is no complete assignment under which every man strictly prefers his partner to his partner in the men-proposing deferred-acceptance assignment.

For finite equal-cardinality strict positive marriage profiles with at least one man, there is no complete assignment under which every man strictly prefers his partner to his partner in the men-proposing deferred-acceptance assignment.

theorem7_later_choice_manipulation_unavo.tex_statement: For every natural rank $k>1$, there is a finite equal-sided market size such that every mechanism stable on all strict positive profiles admits, for some strict true profile, a profitable unilateral strict report by a man or woman that changes the rank of an alternative truly ranked $k$.

For every natural rank $k>1$, there is a finite equal-sided market size such that every mechanism stable on all strict positive profiles admits, for some strict true profile, a profitable unilateral strict report by a man or woman that changes the rank of an alternative truly ranked $k$.

truthfulForAllAgents_iff_source_definiti.tex_statement: A two-sided mechanism is dominant-strategy truthful exactly when, for every strict true profile and every unilateral strict reported profile, neither a man nor a woman obtains a strictly better assigned partner according to that agent’s true score by changing only that agent’s report.

A two-sided mechanism is dominant-strategy truthful exactly when, for every strict true profile and every unilateral strict reported profile, neither a man nor a woman obtains a strictly better assigned partner according to that agent’s true score by changing only that agent’s report.
